The method provides a frame member configured for positioning over a device wall box. The frame member includes at least one opening having a lip that extends substantially into the interior of the wall box. This opening substantially defines a modular space sized and shaped to receive an electrical wiring device.

At least one modular electrical wiring device is configured to conform to the modular space in any of several modular configurations. The device includes attachment structures designed to mate with corresponding portions of the frame member, thereby securing the device within the opening. The modular electrical wiring device may be installed in multiple orientations, including a first orientation and a second orientation that is substantially orthogonal to the first.
outputs.L4:
The invention relates to a mounting system for electrical wiring devices. The system includes a frame configured to be mounted over, or otherwise associated with, a device wall box. The frame defines an opening surrounded by a lip or similar retaining structure. This opening establishes a modular mounting space sized and shaped to receive an electrical wiring device, such as a receptacle, switch, connector, control module, communications outlet, or other electrical accessory.

The electrical wiring device and the frame include complementary attachment structures. When the device is inserted into the modular space, the attachment structures mate with one another to secure the device within the opening. The attachment structures may permit the device to be attached, removed, replaced, or repositioned without requiring replacement of the frame or substantial modification of the wall box. The lip around the opening can help locate, support, align, or retain the device after installation.

The modular mounting space allows the electrical wiring device to be installed in multiple configurations. In particular, the device may be mounted in at least two orthogonal orientations, such as a first orientation and a second orientation rotated approximately ninety degrees relative to the first. The same frame can therefore accommodate different device positions or installation requirements while maintaining a secure mechanical connection.

This arrangement provides a flexible and adaptable platform for electrical installations. Installers may select the orientation and configuration best suited to the available space, wiring arrangement, desired appearance, or intended use. Devices may also be exchanged or reoriented as installation needs change, reducing the need for specialized frames, adapters, or wall-box arrangements.
outputs.L5:
### The Power of “The”

“The” is one of the most frequently used words in the English language. Although it consists of only three letters, it plays an important role in communication. As a definite article, “the” identifies a particular person, place, object, or idea. For example, “a book” can refer to any book, while “the book” points to a specific one.

This small word makes sentences clearer and more precise. It helps speakers and writers distinguish between general concepts and known subjects. “The” may seem ordinary, but without it, English would sound less natural and often be more difficult to understand.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract describing a modular electrical wiring device that mounts in a frame over a wall box and can be installed in two orthogonal orientations.
counterfactuals.output: A modular electrical wiring device assembly includes a mounting frame configured to be secured over an electrical wall box and a wiring device module removably received within an opening of the mounting frame. The wiring device module includes a housing supporting an electrical functional component and one or more terminals connectable to conductors within the wall box. Complementary coupling features on the housing and the mounting frame permit the module to be selectively installed in a first orientation or a second orientation rotated approximately ninety degrees relative to the first orientation. The coupling features retain the module in either orientation while maintaining access to a user-operable portion of the electrical functional component. The assembly thereby enables field-selectable horizontal or vertical positioning of the wiring device without replacing the mounting frame or rewiring the connected conductors.

counterfactuals.prompt: Convert the concept of a rotatable modular wall-box electrical device into formal patent language, emphasizing attachment structures and horizontal or vertical installation.
counterfactuals.output:
## Title  
**Rotatable Modular Electrical Device for Selective Horizontal or Vertical Installation in a Wall Box**

## Abstract  
A modular electrical device assembly is configured for installation within an electrical wall box in either a horizontal orientation or a vertical orientation. The assembly includes an electrical device module, a mounting member securable to the wall box, and complementary attachment structures provided on the electrical device module and the mounting member. The attachment structures permit the electrical device module to be selectively coupled to the mounting member in at least first and second rotational positions angularly offset from one another, such as by approximately ninety degrees. The attachment structures may include tabs, slots, detents, clips, latches, rails, recesses, or combinations thereof, and may provide releasable mechanical retention of the electrical device module. The mounting member can remain secured to the wall box while the electrical device module is detached, rotated, and reattached in the selected horizontal or vertical orientation.

## Exemplary Independent Claim  
1. **A modular electrical device assembly for mounting in an electrical wall box, the assembly comprising:**  
   
   a mounting member configured to be secured to the electrical wall box;  
   
   an electrical device module including an electrical device body and at least one user-accessible operating portion;  
   
   a first attachment structure disposed on the mounting member; and  
   
   a second attachment structure disposed on the electrical device module and configured to releasably engage the first attachment structure,  
   
   wherein the first and second attachment structures are arranged to permit attachment of the electrical device module to the mounting member in a first rotational orientation in which the electrical device module is installed horizontally and in a second rotational orientation in which the electrical device module is installed vertically, the second rotational orientation being angularly displaced from the first rotational orientation about an axis extending generally perpendicular to a front face of the electrical wall box.

## Exemplary Dependent Claims  
2. The modular electrical device assembly of claim 1, wherein the second rotational orientation is displaced from the first rotational orientation by approximately ninety degrees.

3. The modular electrical device assembly of claim 1, wherein the first attachment structure comprises a plurality of attachment features positioned about the mounting member, and the second attachment structure comprises at least one complementary attachment feature selectively engageable with different ones of the plurality of attachment features.

4. The modular electrical device assembly of claim 3, wherein the complementary attachment features comprise one or more tabs and corresponding slots.

5. The modular electrical device assembly of claim 1, wherein the first and second attachment structures comprise a snap-fit connection including at least one resilient latch.

6. The modular electrical device assembly of claim 1, wherein the first and second attachment structures comprise a bayonet-type connection configured to retain the electrical device module following rotation of the electrical device module relative to the mounting member.

7. The modular electrical device assembly of claim 1, wherein the mounting member comprises a mounting frame having openings positioned to receive fasteners that secure the mounting frame to the electrical wall box.

8. The modular electrical device assembly of claim 1, wherein the electrical device module is detachable from and reattachable to the mounting member without removing the mounting member from the electrical wall box.

9. The modular electrical device assembly of claim 1, further comprising at least one detent configured to provide tactile or audible feedback when the electrical device module reaches the first rotational orientation or the second rotational orientation.

10. The modular electrical device assembly of claim 1, further comprising an anti-rotation feature configured to inhibit rotation of the electrical device module after engagement of the first and second attachment structures.

11. The modular electrical device assembly of claim 1, wherein the electrical device module comprises at least one of a receptacle, switch, dimmer, sensor, communication connector, control interface, display, or charging device.

12. The modular electrical device assembly of claim 1, further comprising an electrical connector configured to establish an electrical connection between the electrical device module and conductors associated with the electrical wall box in each of the first and second rotational orientations.

## Exemplary Method Claim  
13. **A method of installing a modular electrical device in an electrical wall box, the method comprising:**  
   
   securing a mounting member to the electrical wall box;  
   
   selecting one of a horizontal installation orientation and a vertical installation orientation for an electrical device module;  
   
   rotating the electrical device module relative to the mounting member about an axis generally perpendicular to an opening of the electrical wall box until the electrical device module is in the selected installation orientation; and  
   
   engaging complementary attachment structures of the electrical device module and the mounting member to retain the electrical device module in the selected installation orientation.

14. The method of claim 13, further comprising disengaging the complementary attachment structures, rotating the electrical device module by approximately ninety degrees, and reengaging the complementary attachment structures without detaching the mounting member from the electrical wall box.

## Specification-Style Description  
The disclosed assembly provides a common mounting platform capable of receiving an electrical device module in multiple angular orientations. In an exemplary embodiment, a mounting frame is fastened to a conventional wall box by screws or other suitable fasteners. The electrical device module includes complementary coupling features that engage attachment features arranged around the mounting frame. The arrangement of the attachment features enables the module to be mounted with its longitudinal axis extending either horizontally or vertically. The coupling features may be rotationally symmetric or may be provided at angularly spaced locations corresponding to predetermined installation positions.

The attachment structures can provide tool-less or tool-assisted coupling and may include resilient clips, hooks, tabs, slots, rails, grooves, threaded fasteners, quarter-turn retainers, detents, locking arms, or combinations thereof. Once installed, a locking or anti-rotation feature can prevent unintended movement of the module. To change the orientation, an installer may release the locking feature, detach or partially disengage the module, rotate the module through approximately ninety degrees, and reattach the module while leaving the mounting frame secured to the wall box.
